sections.content:
Population change in Hounslow in 2032

The population in Hounslow is projected to increase from 291,199 people in 2022 to 304,197 people in 2032.

Despite an overall increase in the population, there is projected to be a fall in net internal migration, which will decrease the population by 55,490 people.

This will also be the biggest factor in population change in most areas in England.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Hounslow
sections.subtitle: How the population is projected to change, by cause
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant
sections.note: The components of change do not always sum exactly to the total population change in an area. This is primarily due to the effect of constraining the final projections to the National Population Projections for England.

sections.content:
Population change is projected by looking at births and deaths (natural change) and people moving in and out of areas. In Hounslow, our projections show that between 2022 and 2032:

  • More births than deaths mean that the population is projected to increase by 15,308, with 33,616 births and 18,308 deaths in Hounslow between 2022 and 2032. This means natural change would increase the population in Hounslow by 5.3%, compared with an increase of 6.0% in London and an increase of 0.2% in England.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other local authorities in England) is projected to reduce the population by 55,490, with 201,852 people moving to the area and 257,342 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would decrease the population in Hounslow by 19.1%.
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) is projected to reduce the population by 1,593, with 4,383 people moving to the area and 5,976 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would decrease the population in Hounslow by 0.5%.
  • Net international migration is projected to increase the population by 54,498, with 95,865 people moving to the area and 41,367 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Hounslow by 18.7%, compared with an increase of 14.7% in London and an increase of 6.5% in England.

sections.content:
Age profile in Hounslow in 2032

The median age in Hounslow is projected to rise from 37 years in 2022 to 38 years in 2032.

In England, the median age is projected to be 41 years in 2032.

In 2032, 13% of the population in Hounslow are projected to be aged 65 years or over, up from 11% in 2022.

sections.title: The 0 to 9 age group are set to see the largest change in Hounslow between 2022 and 2032
sections.subtitle: Percentages of population by 10 year age bands, 2022 and 2032
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant

sections.content:
Between 2022 and 2032, the share of the working age population (people aged 16 years to State Pension age) in Hounslow is projected to stay the same, at around 70%.

The old age dependency ratio (the number of people of State Pension age for every 1,000 people of working age) is projected to rise from 164 to 177 over the same time period.

This is below average for England in 2032 (287 per 1,000). Nationally, a high old age dependency ratio means more older people are financially reliant on the working age population to pay for pensions.

How will the number of young people change in Hounslow?

In 2032, 20% of people are projected to be aged 18 years and under, down from 24% in 2022.

This is the same as the average for England in 2032.

Looking at the youngest age groups in Hounslow between 2022 and 2032, we can see the share of:

  • Infants (aged 0 to 4 years) will fall from 6% to 5%
  • Primary school age children (aged 5 to 11 years) will fall from 9% to 7%
  • Secondary school age children and sixth-form age (aged 12 to 18 years) will fall from 9% to 8%
